paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot, chapter 8, halakhah 10, speaking in the name of Rabbi Yose (the Amora), on the words of Rabbi Abbahu in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 8:10 has Tanchum bar Mari, whereas Hyman supplies bar Mani. It explicitly has Rabbi Abbahu in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, supporting that contextual expansion of ר״י; the Mari/Mani difference is retained.

The whole Guggenheimer Ketubot 8:10 paragraph fully names Rabbi Tanchum bar Mari in Rabbi Yose’s name, and Rabbi Abbahu in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. The local Rabbi titles and contextual אר״י expansion are supported; Hyman’s bar Mani and his Amora parenthesis remain unchanged. Mari and Mani are not bound as one father or repaired in the Hebrew.
